def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")

    # --- Базовая таблица продаж: только заказы, совершённые до seed_time ---
    items = order_items[["order_id", "product_id", "seller_id", "price",
                         "freight_value", "ts"]].copy()
    items = items[items["ts"] < seed_time]

    # --- Платежи: агрегируем по заказу (платёж происходит в момент покупки) ---
    pay_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        installments_max=("payment_installments", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже существуют на момент seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[["order_id", "review_score", "review_creation_date"]].copy()
    rev = rev[rev["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_score_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_count=("review_score", "count"),
        review_bad=("review_score", lambda s: (s <= 2).sum()),
        review_good=("review_score", lambda s: (s >= 4).sum()),
    ).reset_index()

    df = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df = df.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df = df[df["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    df["days_before"] = (seed_time - df["ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    def empty_block(cols):
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=cols)

    def window_features(data, lo, hi, suffix):
        """lo <= days_before < hi (hi=None -> без верхней границы)."""
        cols = [
            f"count_{suffix}", f"qty_{suffix}", f"sum_price_{suffix}",
            f"avg_price_{suffix}", f"sum_freight_{suffix}", f"avg_freight_{suffix}",
            f"sum_payment_{suffix}", f"avg_installments_{suffix}",
            f"avg_review_{suffix}", f"review_cnt_{suffix}",
            f"bad_review_ratio_{suffix}", f"good_review_ratio_{suffix}",
            f"n_sellers_{suffix}", f"n_customers_{suffix}",
        ]
        if data is None or data.empty:
            return empty_block(cols)
        mask = data["days_before"] >= lo
        if hi is not None:
            mask &= data["days_before"] < hi
        sub = data[mask]
        if sub.empty:
            return empty_block(cols)
        g = sub.groupby("product_id")
        out = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
        out[f"count_{suffix}"] = g["order_id"].nunique()
        out[f"qty_{suffix}"] = g.size()
        out[f"sum_price_{suffix}"] = g["price"].sum()
        out[f"avg_price_{suffix}"] = g["price"].mean()
        out[f"sum_freight_{suffix}"] = g["freight_value"].sum()
        out[f"avg_freight_{suffix}"] = g["freight_value"].mean()
        out[f"sum_payment_{suffix}"] = g["payment_sum"].sum()
        out[f"avg_installments_{suffix}"] = g["installments_max"].mean()
        out[f"avg_review_{suffix}"] = g["review_score_mean"].mean()
        out[f"review_cnt_{suffix}"] = g["review_count"].sum()
        out[f"bad_review_ratio_{suffix}"] = g["review_bad"].sum() / out[f"review_cnt_{suffix}"].replace(0, np.nan)
        out[f"good_review_ratio_{suffix}"] = g["review_good"].sum() / out[f"review_cnt_{suffix}"].replace(0, np.nan)
        out[f"n_sellers_{suffix}"] = g["seller_id"].nunique()
        out[f"n_customers_{suffix}"] = g["order_id"].nunique()
        out = out.fillna(0.0)
        out = out.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)
        return out[cols]

    windows = [(0, 30, "30d"), (30, 60, "prev30d"), (0, 90, "90d"),
               (90, 180, "90_180d"), (0, None, "all")]
    blocks = [window_features(df, lo, hi, sfx) for lo, hi, sfx in windows]
    features = pd.concat(blocks, axis=1)

    # --- Тренды ---
    features["count_trend_30d"] = features["count_30d"] - features["count_prev30d"]
    features["sum_price_trend_30d"] = features["sum_price_30d"] - features["sum_price_prev30d"]
    features["count_ratio_30d"] = features["count_30d"] / (features["count_prev30d"] + 1.0)

    # --- Возраст товара и давность последней продажи ---
    if df.empty:
        features["age_days"] = 0.0
        features["recency_days"] = 9999.0
        features["days_since_first_ever"] = 0.0
    else:
        g = df.groupby("product_id")["ts"]
        first_sale = g.min()
        last_sale = g.max()
        features["age_days"] = (seed_time - first_sale).dt.total_seconds().div(86400.0)
        features["recency_days"] = (seed_time - last_sale).dt.total_seconds().div(86400.0)
        # доля продаж за последние 30 дней от всех продаж
        features["share_30d_of_all"] = features["qty_30d"] / (features["qty_all"] + 1.0)
        features["share_90d_of_all"] = features["qty_90d"] / (features["qty_all"] + 1.0)

    features["recency_days"] = features["recency_days"].fillna(9999.0)
    features["age_days"] = features["age_days"].fillna(0.0)

    # --- Средний интервал между продажами (активность) ---
    if not df.empty:
        span = df.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(lambda s: (s.max() - s.min()).total_seconds() / 86400.0)
        cnt = df.groupby("product_id").size()
        gap = (span / cnt.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
        features["avg_gap_days"] = gap.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)
    else:
        features["avg_gap_days"] = 0.0

    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(idx)
    features = features.fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    return features
